payload.text: 3.3.0, THE ONE NEXT RELEASE (hv directive 1, decision 109). OWED BY hv, as vc put each to hv in chat on 2026-11-10 by 13:26Z on vc's date -u, most blocking first, each with vc's recommendation, and none answered yet. (1) The ratification of ST0092's terms document on twelve points and two wording fixes, all as WP-01's body has them (todo 76): cc's whole lane waits on it. (2) Whether a client's name is confidential in Intent's public record (watchout 34): the push waits on it. If yes, vc rewrites the one message of c1d7d163d before the push, with every seat held, the commits on top of it taking new hashes and the old history kept under a local ref; if no, the push is clear on that point. (3) Which remotes a cut pushes to: vc recommends local and upstream alone, as it is being built (watchout 33). (4) Whether the contract check becomes a release gate: vc recommends arming it (decision 114). (5) Whether Intent keeps an AT's own red-then-green: vc recommends keeping it where the red is the code as it was and never a defect someone made up. (6) The shape of issue 0665: vc recommends that doctor names the drift and nothing reopens. hv also owes a first-hand word on the three rulings devbin-vc relayed (decision 113). 3.3.0 ALSO WAITS ON DEVBIN'S NEXT RELEASE, which hv fires: it carries the pre-flight seam and the release commit's trailer (decision 113, todo 71), and it is swept into Intent's tree before the cut. THE HOLD OF hv's THIRD COMPACT IS LIFTED (decision 116): dc and ic build again, and devbin-vc holds hv's pen and the desk while hv is away. WHERE THE LANES STAND, each seat directed by vc on hv's word of 2026-11-10 (decision 111). cc: holds for the ratification (its hold 35), with its notes on the hand form and its eleven builder points taken into the packages. dc: ST0091/01 and ST0091/04 are WIP and claimed; WP-04's trigger change is banked as the train's first unit, and WP-01, now L, follows as two banks to vc's rulings (decisions 112, 114 and 115); then WP-02 and WP-03, issue 0670 in the shape its record carries, issue 0665 once hv has ruled its shape, and issue 0649, measured first. ic: issue 0661 is on main at c37c21d86, judged by vc on the whole suite and verified against the judged tree path by path; 0650's fix is banked whole and not yet run at refs/bank/ic/0650/fix-v1-on-1fe4a4bec (blob bda6c11cda55), from tmp/wt-ic-0650; then 0672 in the full shape (todo 75), 0676 and 0677, and for ST0092 each of cc's surface rows and WP-10. THE PUSH: hold 8. BEFORE THE CUT: Devbin's next release is swept in; hv says which remotes the cut pushes to and release.remotes is declared (watchout 33); hv sees ST0090's row on a 3.3.0 build (hold 6); every package and issue above is landed and its gate read. THE CUT is hv's, once. AFTER IT: ST0092's sweep. Every heavy run is booked with the estate's controller, agentic-engineering-vc. Its measured figures for Intent, all of 2026-11-10: a one-module run from a warm target 15 seconds, an incremental rebuild with three arms 16 seconds, cold builds of intentd and the CLI 32 and 19 seconds, and the whole-suite judge 6 minutes at a load near 5 and 7 minutes at a load near 10. The bats half of a judge was last measured on 2026-10-27 (refs/bank/vc/evidence/judge-run3/stamps): the release pair 1m47s on a warm target and the bats tree 4m34s for 847 arms.
